questions.stem: If the recommended rate for orange tree is $$ 2.5m \times 2.5m $$, what will be the number of orange trees in **two hectare** of land?
explanation_steps:
**Step 1: Calculate the area of one tree.**
Area per tree = $$ 2.5m \times 2.5m = 6.25 m^2 $$

**Step 2: Convert hectares to square meters.**
1 hectare = $$ 10,000 m^2 $$
2 hectares = $$ 20,000 m^2 $$

**Step 3: Calculate the number of trees.**
Number of trees = $$ \frac{\text{Total Area}}{\text{Area per tree}} $$
Number = $$ \frac{20,000}{6.25} = 3200 \text{ trees} $$

questions.stem: If the altitude of Hamelmalo is 2300 m above sea level, then **calculate** the average temperature of Hamelmalo.
explanation_steps:
**Step 1: Identify the formula.**
In Eritrea, the standard formula to estimate average annual temperature ($$ T $$) based on altitude in meters ($$ h $$) is:
$$ T = 30.2 - 0.006 \times h $$

**Step 2: Substitute the given altitude.**
$$ h = 2300 \text{ m} $$
$$ T = 30.2 - (0.006 \times 2300) $$

**Step 3: Perform the calculation.**
$$ 0.006 \times 2300 = 13.8 $$
$$ T = 30.2 - 13.8 $$
$$ T = 16.4 ^\circ C $$

Table-1: Hypothetical production function of Wheat.

| Fertilizer level(Kg/ha) | TPP (Quintal/ha) | MPP | MVP | Price per unit of fertilizer (Nkf) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | 10 | -------- | --------- | 20 |
| 5 | 20 | | | 20 |
| 10 | 40 | | 80 | 20 |
| 15 | 70 | | | 20 |
| 20 | 75 | | | 20 |
| 25 | 85 | | | 20 |
| 30 | 80 | | | 20 |

A) Find App at 10 Kg/ha fertilizer level
B) Find MPP at 30 Kg/ha fertilizer level
C) Find the Price per unit product of wheat in Nakfa

questions.answer: A) 4, B) -1, C) 20 Nkf, D) 20 Kg/ha
accepted_answers: A) 4, B) -1, C) 20 Nkf, D) 20 Kg/ha
explanation_steps:
**A) App at 10:** $$ App = \frac{TPP}{X} = \frac{40}{10} = 4 $$ quintal/kg.

**B) MPP at 30:** $$ MPP = \frac{\Delta TPP}{\Delta X} = \frac{80 - 85}{30 - 25} = \frac{-5}{5} = -1 $$ quintal/kg.

**C) Price of Wheat:** At level 10, $$ MPP = \frac{40-20}{10-5} = 4 $$. Given $$ MVP = 80 $$. Since $$ MVP = MPP \times P_y $$, then $$ 80 = 4 \times P_y \implies P_y = 20 $$ Nkf/quintal.

**D) Profit Max:** Occurs where $$ MVP = \text{Price of fertilizer} $$. At level 20, $$ MPP = \frac{75-70}{20-15} = 1 $$. $$ MVP = 1 \times 20 = 20 $$. Since Price of fert is 20, profit is maximized at **20 Kg/ha**.
